paragraphs: Rav Shalman of Bei Kaluchit (or Tzaluchit).
Mentioned in [Beitzah 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.5b.9), together with Rav Adda.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Kaluchit and Tzaluchit are the source’s alternative place forms; their vowels and location are not independently established.

The linked passage calls both Rav Adda and Rav Shalman men of Bei Kaluchit. They give a joint ruling about the festival egg. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3327&lang=en) records both place-name forms and cites the same occurrence.
